last_summary: Both videos have enough evidence for the pre-cooking egg mixture: v1 shows butter and milk whisked before eggs are added; v2 shows eggs whisked alone before cooking, with no other ingredient visibly added to the bowl.
review_reason: The focus on the v2 whisking interval revealed a uniform yellow mixture and no visible additions, which strongly suggests eggs-only but does not definitively rule out small quantities of liquid additives due to sparse frames and potential gaps.
